name: Orbbec SDK v1
summary: Orbbec SDK v1 is a cross-platform library for acquiring and processing data from supported Orbbec RGB-D cameras. It provides device control, stream access and integration wrappers for ROS and ROS 2. This older SDK generation continues to support legacy devices that differ from the v2 support matrix.
